column1: This file was created using the 202604 CRSP database.
It contains value-weighted returns for the intersections of  5 ME portfolios
The portfolios are constructed daily.  ME is market cap at the end of the
previous day.  PRIOR_RET is from - 250 to - 21.
Missing data are indicated by -99.99 or -999.
